taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: FileProvider root selection and temporary URI permission scope
controls.source_trace: Trace which app receives which URI and whether it can access files beyond the intended shared object through path/root or grant handling.
controls.implementation_branch: Trace configured roots, canonical path resolution, manifest export/grant settings and individual Intent/ClipData grants. A broad root is potential reach, not proof an attacker has a usable URI grant. Separate read from write and persisted versus temporary access; use owned marker files and verify the effective recipient operation and grant revocation.
controls.operational_method: Record provider root mapping, canonical file, actual recipient and grant flags on Intent/ClipData, including prefix scope where supported. Separate read/write and actual supported persistability; a client requesting persistence does not make every provider grant persistable. Compare a marker URI with a sibling/outside-root URI and observe permissions after the documented temporary-grant lifetime/revocation event. Exported=false alone does not invalidate an explicitly issued grant.
controls.controlled_verification: Use owned emulator apps and synthetic files inside/outside a share root; compare intended URI access and one unauthorized file request.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A content URI or broad-looking path XML is not arbitrary file access without an effective granted/open path.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain roots and URI grants, then retest legitimate shares, grant lifetime and outside-file denial.
